question: 2026年8月末临期库存量最大的十个经销商

sql:
WITH dealer AS (
  SELECT dealer_id, dealer_name
  FROM dim_dealer_history
  WHERE is_current = TRUE
),
inv AS (
  SELECT 
    fi.dealer_id,

JOIN dealer ON inv.dealer_id = dealer.dealer_id

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH sales_by_region_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        销量,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY 销量 DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales_by_region_sku
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    sku_name AS 销量最高单品
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 各渠道净销额占全渠道净销额合计的比例
sql:
WITH total AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
)
SELECT 
    d.year_month AS 年月,
    SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF((SELECT total_net FROM total), 0) AS 净销额占比
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.year_month
ORDER BY d.year_month

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.brand,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    b.brand AS 品牌,
    b.brand_net_amount / t.total_net_amount * 100 AS 净销额占比
FROM brand_sales b
CROSS JOIN total_sales t
WHERE b.brand_net_amount / t.total_net_amount > 0.10
ORDER BY 净销额占比 DESC

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数
FROM (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT AVG(终端净销额)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) AS 终端净销额
            FROM fact_sales s2
            JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
            GROUP BY s2.outlet_id
        ) t
    )
) sub

question: 每个品类销量最高的三个单品
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

)

FROM ranked

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    a.category AS 品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b 
    ON a.category = b.category 
    AND a.year_month = '2026-08' 
    AND b.year_month = '2026-07'
WHERE a.total_qty > b.total_qty

)

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS sales_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        mi.dealer_id,
        mi.total_on_hand,
        COALESCE(ms.total_qty, 0) AS total_qty,
        COALESCE(ms.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days
    FROM monthly_inventory mi
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
)
SELECT 
    c.dealer_id,
    c.total_on_hand / NULLIF(c.total_qty / NULLIF(c.sales_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM combined c
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.region, p.region) AS 大区,
    (COALESCE(c.current_net_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_net_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(p.previous_net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.region = p.region
ORDER BY 大区

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE
    AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS ratio
  FROM s
  JOIN c ON s.year_month = c.year_month
),
period_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN year_month >= '2025-07' AND year_month <= '2025-12' THEN '2025H2'
      WHEN year_month >= '2026-01' AND year_month <= '2026-06' THEN '2026H1'
    END AS period,
    SUM(amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cost), 0) AS ratio
  FROM (
    SELECT s.year_month, s.amt, c.cost
    FROM s
    JOIN c ON s.year_month = c.year_month
  ) t
  WHERE year_month >= '2025-07' AND year_month <= '2026-06'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN ratio END) - 
  MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN ratio END) AS 费效比提升
FROM period_ratio
